title: Supplemental Material (DiffPrivacyScatterplotUtility)
summary: Supplemental notebooks and data for a study on differentially private scatterplot visualizations, including notebooks that densify scatterplot data to a fixed point count and compute statistical utility metrics comparing private and original plots. The scatterplotDensification and UtilityMetrics notebooks install and rely on the copulas package and the sdv package (bundling sdmetrics, ctgan, rdt) to generate/augment points and evaluate utility, though no explicit call sites beyond the pip install logs are shown in the harvested evidence.
evidence: UtilityMetrics.ipynb:741-760 shows pip install of sdv (pulling in sdmetrics, ctgan, rdt, copulas) with no visible call site in the harvested context.
needs: Evidence is limited to pip-install log lines in notebook outputs; no code cells showing actual API calls to copulas/sdv were captured, so real usage (e.g., GaussianMultivariate for densification, sdmetrics/CTGAN for utility evaluation) could not be confirmed.
